title: Use the Alerts Center
summary: What each part shows: summary by priority, alerts by category, the patient, the status, the history and the actions.
keywords: what do i have to do

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Summary
steps.details: How many pending alerts there are in total and how many are critical, high and medium priority.

steps.title: Filters
steps.details: By status (pending, completed, action taken, ignored, suppressed) and by priority.

steps.title: Categories
steps.details: Alerts are grouped by category (appointments, billing, follow-up, patients, reminders, dates). The category's checkbox selects all its alerts.

steps.title: An alert
steps.details: The color strip is the priority. Below the title you see the data that created it, the action history and the status.

steps.title: View patient
steps.details: The title opens the patient's record.

steps.title: Send WhatsApp
steps.details: Sends the rule's WhatsApp template to the patient. Disabled if they have no phone or the rule has no template.

steps.title: Send email
steps.details: Opens the email with the rule's text so you can review and send it.

steps.title: Log call
steps.details: Notes that you called, when and what was discussed.

steps.title: Snooze
steps.details: Removes it from the inbox until a date (1 day, 3 days, 1 week or another).

steps.title: Ignore
steps.details: Dismisses it with a reason, without doing anything.

steps.title: Add note
steps.details: A comment for the team; it stays in the alert's history.
